caption: The drawing depicts two views of an oval-shaped, wooden box; the top view is above, and the bottom view is below, both rendered on a plain beige background. The box is reddish-brown in color, with lighter and darker wood grain visible. Decorative carvings are present on both surfaces. The top view shows the box’s lid, which is adorned with an intricate central design resembling an abstract or symbolic motif, surrounded by smaller, curving lines and shapes, some of which appear to form stylized patterns. The side of the box features additional carved decorations, including elongated, heart-like and looped shapes. The bottom view presents the underside of the box, also with etched, curling designs and a sequence of numbers or symbols that suggest a date or inscription. Four small, circular metal studs are visible in the corners of the box’s underside. The drawing includes the artist’s signature “Ethel Rivers” in red ink in the lower right corner.
title: Bishop Hill: Bridal Box
